narrative.overview:
The panel reads as the material it handles. A cement-paper L-frame (#E8E4DC) holds exactly one white work sheet; everything the worker reads sits on that sheet like a delivery note on a desk. The palette is the palette of the warehouse itself: kraft paper, cement grey, warm ink, and one signal orange that behaves like a safety marking — rare, functional, impossible to miss. Dense tables are laid in brick courses (tongadas) on a 44px ceramic module pitch, so scanning a queue feels like reading a wall of labeled bays. When a reception is validated, a rubber stamp lands on the row: CONFORME, tilted, slightly out of register — the one authored moment in an otherwise still, operational interface.

This world refuses the neutral card kit where every block floats on grey behind an icon in a tinted square. It is flat by doctrine: depth comes from a single tone step (frame vs. sheet, row vs. hover) and hairline rules, never from shadows. Density is medium-high and deliberate — 44px rows, 24px gutters, tabular figures — because the worker lives in this screen across a full shift and scansability beats expression. The status language is material too: verdicts are stamped, states are tinted chips in olive, amber and rust, and every number is set in a condensed industrial face that reads as measured quantity.
keyCharacteristics: One tinted L-frame, one white work sheet — maximum three nesting levels (frame, sheet, card).
One chroma only: signal orange on the mark, the single primary action and the main data figure/series.
Status as material: rubber stamps for verdicts, pale-tint pills for states (olive / amber / rust on their own hue’s tint).
Two faces with one job each: Archivo for prose, Barlow Condensed for every figure, code and ubicación.
Flat, shadowless depth; brick-course table rules at every dock change; 44px module pitch.

rules.name: The One Chroma Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange is the only chroma in the system. It marks the brand, the single primary action and the one data figure that is the problem to act on. Its rarity is the point; a second hue (a blue, a violet, a green action) breaks the world.

rules.name: The Contrast-Safe Step Rule
rules.body: The accent steps down before it touches type or fills: #C24A1A under white button text (5.3:1), #A63D16 for small text on white (4.8:1). The raw #D95D2B appears only as 2px borders, the mark stroke and data bars — never as text.

rules.name: The Same-Hue Status Rule
rules.body: Status = pale tint + dark ink of one hue (olive, amber, rust). Never a saturated chip, never a colored dot alone, never hue-as-decoration.

rules.name: The Figure Face Rule
rules.body: Every figure, code and ubicación is Barlow Condensed with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (the .num utility). Archivo never sets a number in a data context; Barlow Condensed never sets a sentence.

rules.name: The Quiet Header Rule
rules.body: Table headers are 12px regular muted with no fill and no rule — the data, not the chrome, carries the emphasis.

rules.name: The Course Rule
rules.body: Long tables are laid like brick courses: 44px rows, a hairline --rule between rows of one course, and the heavier --rule-course where a new course starts (dock change). The courses are the table’s structure — don’t zebra-stripe over them.

rules.name: The Flat Frame Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and flat in response. Hover is a tone step (--raised), focus is a 2px outline, elevation is nesting. Never a shadow, glow, blur or gradient — including under the sheet.

rules.name: The Radius Encodes Rank Rule
rules.body: Radius follows nesting depth: 16 sheet, 8 card, 6 control, 4 chip. A card may not wear the sheet’s radius, and no fourth nesting level exists to need a fifth step.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: Exactly one accent-filled action per screen, right-aligned in the title row, naming the screen’s main task. A second #C24A1A button means one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: The rubber stamp is reserved for conformity verdicts and is the only element allowed to rotate, letter-space, or animate. Its -2deg / +2deg tilt and its landing are the world’s signature — spending them elsewhere spends the signature.

rules.name: The Dashed Slot Rule
rules.body: Loading and empty share one dashed slot with words in it. No spinners, no skeletons, no empty-state illustrations.

dos: Do keep the accent as the only chroma: mark, one primary action, main data figure/series (#D95D2B and its #C24A1A / #A63D16 steps).
Do set every number, code and ubicación in Barlow Condensed with tabular figures, right-aligned in tables.
Do lay long tables in brick courses: --row-height: 44px rows, --rule within a course, --rule-course at each dock change.
Do express status as stamp (verdict) or same-hue tint pill (state): olive #2F4526/#E4EDE0, amber #6B551B/#F5EDD5, rust #832A17/#F7E3DC.
Do convey depth with tone steps and hairlines (--raised hover, --ground-deep seated blocks, #EAE7E0 edges).
Do hold the gutter discipline: 24px padding and gaps everywhere on the sheet; the KPI strip’s cells split by hairlines, not gaps.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on the stamp.
donts: Don’t add a second hue — no blue links, no green confirmations, no violet charts. Color is orange or it is ink.
Don’t use shadows, glows, blurs or gradients anywhere, including under the sheet.
Don’t put a border between the sidebar and the top bar; the L is one continuous ground (the folded state’s bottom rule at 1100px is the one exception).
Don’t nest a fourth level beyond frame → sheet → card, and don’t let a card wear the sheet’s 16px radius.
Don’t rotate, stamp or animate anything that is not a conformity verdict.
Don’t fill table headers, add zebra striping, or drop the course rules — the brick courses are the table’s structure.
Don’t use icon glyphs in tinted squares as decoration; navigation and status are words (the logo mark is the only glyph in the system).
Don’t set figures in Archivo or prose in Barlow Condensed.
Don’t render empty or loading states as spinners, skeletons or illustrations — use the dashed slot with words.
Don’t give a screen two primary actions or different gutters for adjacent rows (24px everywhere).
